sources.snippet: NekoAI is an open-source, AI-powered desktop pet that lives on your screen. It wanders around your windows, reacts to what you do, and when you need it — it thinks, answers, and helps, right there on your desktop. It's a love letter to the 90s/00s desktop companions (Neko, eSheep, Shimeji) rebuilt with a modern stack and a real AI brain inside.
